features: Super Heat, Sandstorms, and Electrical Storms.
Extremely hot temperatures in the day.
Evaporation of Water in Canteens and Water Jars.
Electrical Generators that take damage whenever used.
Heat Stroke, which causes damage and creates a blurry effect on-screen. (Similar to being drunk)
Oil and Water Veins, which can be used to produce Oil and Water, respectively.
The Wyvern Trench and the caves host rich crystal nodes which yield a very high amount of Crystal.
asa_changes: New ruins to explore (including a colosseum redesign and two new caves)
Fasolasuchus and Oasisaur dossiers on map.
Consuming Cactus Sap now provides +1 water directly, as opposed to the aforementioned water being derived from harvesting the cacti.
Certain wild creatures may now occasionally be seen followed with a wild baby.
New optional paid Adventure Pack for Scorched Earth, introducing additional features to the DLC.
Tamed Creatures now drop Death Essence upon death, allowing for revival within 24 real-life hours of the Creature's death.
Jerboa is no longer capped to spawn at level 1, spawning now as a normal creature.
Morellatops adjustment, now it has a Water stat to improve its water storage capacity, also it can water crops.
Phoenix has a new land mechanic and their corresponding animations, also it can spawn with more color variations, including: orange, red, blue, green, and pink.
